panels.title: S3 LIST requests — ingest-bucket (1h)
panels.description: Count of S3 LIST requests against ingest-bucket in the last hour. Each uploader cycle on every edge runs a LIST to compare local against remote, so this is a reliable proxy for s3-uploader liveness. SeaweedFS does NOT increment its s3_request_total counter for the actual upload PUT bodies (those go through the volume server directly, bypassing the S3 layer counters), which is why we can't show a true 'PUTs to ingest-bucket' panel.

panels.title: Volume server disk used
panels.description: Total bytes occupied by SeaweedFS volume files on /data/seaweedfs (the hostPath PVC). Includes all buckets.

panels.title: S3 requests/min (last 5m)
panels.description: Rolling 5-minute average request rate against the S3 endpoint, scaled to per-minute. Drops to 0 during quiet periods.

panels.title: Volumes (across all buckets)
panels.description: Number of SeaweedFS volume files currently allocated. Grows in 30 GB increments as data lands.

panels.title: S3 request rate by HTTP code
panels.description: Per-second request rate against the S3 endpoint, broken down by response code. A spike in 4xx/5xx indicates client errors or SeaweedFS distress.

panels.title: S3 request rate by operation type
panels.description: Same source data sliced by request type: PUT (uploads), GET (reads), LIST (catalog), DELETE.
